recipe.visualDefinition: A grotesque, caricatured one-man band musician walking on a tiny, spherical island in the middle of the ocean. The musician is laden with instruments including a bass drum on his back and a guitar. To the right, a single palm tree with a cannabis-leaf-shaped canopy leans over. The sky is a smooth, warm gradient from yellow to orange-pink, contrasting with the dark blue sea.
coreVisualRelationships: The musician's exaggerated, screaming facial expression mirrors the chaotic energy of the hand-drawn lettering.
The curve of the tiny island matches the lean of the palm tree, creating a circular flow.
The sharp, jagged ink lines of the character contrast with the soft, airbrushed gradient of the background sky.
coreInvariants: Grotesque, elongated facial features with an open, screaming mouth.
A single palm tree with a distinct seven-pointed serrated leaf canopy.
A spherical island with a road painted down the center.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The musician is the central figure, occupying the lower-left quadrant, scaled to appear large relative to the tiny island.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large bass drum on the musician's back acts as a circular anchor in the mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the aggressive lettering in the top left, follows the musician's gaze right toward the palm tree, and circles down the island's curve back to the character.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper right sky allows the palm leaf and the main title to breathe.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue (ocean) and black (ink outlines).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red (musician's jacket) and green (palm leaf).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the character and sky; low value/dark tones in the ocean and ink linework.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Aggressive, tall sans-serif with varying stroke widths.
letterConstructionRules: Inconsistent x-height and baseline for a jittery, energetic feel.
Heavy ink bleed and splatter effects on the strokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' characters have sharp, pointed peaks.
The 'M' and 'N' have deep, jagged valleys.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The main title uses aggressive, scratchy lettering while the secondary text on the drum uses a more rounded, casual hand-drawn style.
graphicDevices: Halftone-like texture in the sky gradient

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, scratchy energy of the original.
Matches the ink-splatter and grotesque caricature aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A surreal ink and watercolor illustration of a grotesque one-man band character with a screaming face, walking on a tiny spherical island with a road. A single palm tree with a cannabis-shaped leaf leans from the right. The background is a smooth airbrushed gradient from yellow to orange-pink over a dark blue sea. Style is reminiscent of 1970s satirical caricature.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the top left using custom, scratchy, aggressive black ink lettering with sharp points and ink splatters. Add secondary casual hand-drawn text inside the circle of the bass drum on the character's back.

verificationChecks: Is the mouth of the character wide open in a scream?
Does the palm tree have a distinct seven-pointed leaf?
Is the sky a smooth sunset gradient?
Is the lettering jagged and aggressive?

adjustableVariables: Degree of caricature in the musician's face
Amount of ink splatter on the lettering
mustRedesign: Exact facial likeness of the original character
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the character is carrying multiple instruments including a drum and guitar.
Verify the road on the island follows the spherical curve.
Check that the lettering feels integrated into the sky through texture.
Confirm the palm leaf is clearly recognizable as the intended shape.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Grotesque Caricature Character] with [Tiny Spherical Island] and [Aggressive Ink Lettering] set against a [Sunset Gradient Sky] to recreate the 70s surrealist rock aesthetic.
